bugs.title: Stale StateStore snapshot reused after await
bugs.invariant: Snapshot objects returned by snapshot acquisition calls may not be dereferenced after a suspension point unless refreshed after the final await.

bugs.title: Raw eval on request-supplied expression
bugs.invariant: Code must never call eval/exec on a value that is not a static literal.

bugs.title: doctor/scan hang on unenrolled root
bugs.invariant: File collection must never execute against a root without a corpus dir; unenrolled roots yield empty scope immediately.

bugs.title: show/related/synthesize leak raw Errno on missing BugCase
bugs.invariant: Missing records must surface as named errors (enrollment state or bug id), never raw OSErrors.

bugs.title: hook entrypoints block on terminal stdin
bugs.invariant: Hook entrypoints must never block on terminal stdin; no piped event means no work, reported by instant silent exit 0.
